tools.name: wellfred_resolve_location
tools.description: Resolve a Costa Rican province, town or district to current catalog IDs and locality centers. Empty query lists the seven active Costa Rican provinces. Province searches use provinceUuid; locality centers are not a customer address. Return candidates and clarify ambiguous names.

tools.name: wellfred_service_categories
tools.description: Browse the current WellFred service taxonomy in English and Spanish when choosing a service category.

tools.name: wellfred_provider_details
tools.description: Read a public WellFred provider profile from a returned provider UUID before comparing or explaining its services. tools.name: wellfred_service_availability
tools.description: Check a returned WellFred service and option on a specific date before discussing reservation times. Slots do not prove party capacity or exact-address coverage.

tools.name: wellfred_search_classes
tools.description: Use when the customer specifically wants classes in Costa Rica. Search only current public WellFred classes; use services for general provider/service needs. Use a resolved locality center if the customer supplied an area. Results do not establish seat availability.

tools.name: wellfred_search_events
tools.description: Use when the customer specifically wants upcoming events or retreats in Costa Rica. Search only current public WellFred events with active upcoming dates. An empty result does not mean a provider has never offered events. Use services for ongoing offerings.

tools.name: wellfred_prepare_booking
tools.description: After the customer approves the returned service, time and known price/currency, prepare an email-verified confirmation link on WellFred. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wellfred_search_services, wellfred_provider_details, wellfred_render_services, wellfred_offering_detail · Private data: wellfred_provider_details · Public sink: wellfred_prepare_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wellfred_search_services, wellfred_provider_details, wellfred_render_services, wellfred_offering_detail · Private data: wellfred_provider_details · Public sink: wellfred_prepare_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
